Verses.Text: He answered, But I see four men walking about free in the fire, unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of God.
Bless the LORD, all you who are holy and humble of heart.
Daniel continued his custom of going home to kneel in prayer and give thanks to his God in the upper chamber three times a day, with the windows open toward Jerusalem.
As the visions during the night continued, I saw coming with the clouds of heaven one like a Son of man.
